issues.description: preview_fn contract is unspecified: signature, purity, failure semantics, and node.preview() behavior are undocumented
issues.detail: Docs introduce preview_fn as 'a callable that returns a preview payload' but never state the required signature, whether it must be pure or side-effect free, what node.preview() returns when absent, or how exceptions propagate. Best-practice 'wrap in try-except if needed' substitutes defensive code for a stated failure mode. Callers cannot reason about it; every user will guess differently.

issues.description: meta dict overloads two concerns: opaque metadata and renderer configuration
issues.detail: The same meta carries Mermaid renderer config, nested textStyle, code language hints, and arbitrary user metadata (timestamps, versions). Docs admit meta serves 'two purposes,' conflating distinct contracts through one untyped dict and leaking renderer concerns into the abstraction. Separate render_config from meta, or at minimum document reserved keys.

issues.description: Preview supertype contract and per-subtype preconditions are documented by example only
issues.detail: The PR introduces a family of Preview subtypes (Json, Table, Plotly, Mermaid, Image, Text, Custom) without stating the supertype's required fields, to_dict() shape, or per-subtype content schema. TablePreview's list[dict] precondition is stronger than peers but buried in a Note. CustomPreview's renderer_key leaks a Kedro-Viz frontend coupling with no ownership or unknown-key semantics defined.

issues.description: Basic-usage example uses `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` — obscure and order-unspecified
issues.detail: The retrieval is equivalent to `pipeline.nodes[0]` written obscurely, with no stated invariant about pipeline.nodes ordering. Copy-pasted into user code this becomes cargo cult. Use indexing or state the ordering contract; don't teach by example a retrieval whose postcondition is unstated.

issues.description: ImagePreview example contains unreachable code after `return`
issues.detail: The data-URI alternative is shown as a commented-out block after the return statement, leaving two returns where one is dead. A skimming reader sees broken control flow. Split into two named functions or parameterize; don't teach users to leave dead returns in their code.

issues.description: Examples are not runnable: Ellipsis literals, missing imports, and undefined functions
issues.detail: CustomPreview shows `"nodes": [...]` and `"edges": [...]` which serialize to runtime Ellipsis. Mermaid and Text snippets reference undefined `process_data`/`calculate_metrics` and omit `from kedro.pipeline import node`. Either make each snippet self-contained and runnable or mark it explicitly as a fragment.
issues.lines: mermaid, text, and custom preview sections

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a documentation patch that ships a useful experimental feature without writing down its contracts. The dominant failure is unspecified semantics for preview_fn and the Preview type family — signature, purity, failure mode, per-subtype preconditions, and node.preview() behavior are all left to example inference. Secondary structural concern: the meta dict overloads opaque metadata with renderer configuration, and CustomPreview leaks a Kedro-Viz frontend coupling. Example code has propagating sloppiness — obscure `next(...)` retrieval, unreachable returns, Ellipsis literals, and undefined references. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — specify contracts, separate render config from meta, and make examples runnable before this leaves experimental.
